case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Reviews repeatedly praise the hotel's central location, friendly staff and generally good breakfast and cleanliness. Several guests noted small rooms with limited storage and amenities (no kettle/coffee), and some reported significant street/market noise and poor soundproofing. A few comments mentioned cramped bathrooms, limited daylight in courtyard-facing rooms, elevator inconvenience, a luggage-storage fee, and occasional crowded breakfast service.
